summary_md: **Naman Jain ([@jus_eng_njainam](https://x.com/jus_eng_njainam/status/2115265143957266501))** flags a trap in NVIDIA's DGX Spark tuning post for Ling-3.0-flash: enabling the FP8 output head together with MTP drafting without sharing the whole head module makes the draft read FP8 weights as BF16, so accept length falls to 1.00 — slower than no tuning at all. Links NVIDIA's *3 Ways to Boost MoE Inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark*.

referenced_urls.title: 3 Ways to Boost MoE Inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark | NVIDIA Technical Blog

relevance: A specific DGX Spark MoE tuning pitfall worth knowing before copying NVIDIA's recipe.
